title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Explore the village of Hamilton, a historic district just down the hill from campus where student life meets local commerce.

cards.title: Colgate Bookstore
cards.subtitle: Utica Street
cards.notes: Visit the largest independent bookstore in Central NY to find textbooks, university apparel, and school supplies in a historic three-story building.
cards.short_summary: The university's primary retail hub for textbooks and gear located in downtown Hamilton.
cards.evidence_claim: The Colgate Bookstore is located in a historic three-story building at 3 Utica Street in the heart of Hamilton, NY.
cards.access_notes: Open daily to the public; easily accessible via the Colgate Shuttle.

cards.title: Colgate Inn
cards.subtitle: Payne Street
cards.notes: Stop by this landmark hotel and restaurant facing the Village Green, often described as the front door to the university for visitors.
cards.short_summary: A historic hotel and dining establishment that serves as a central gathering point for the community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Colgate Inn is located at 1 Payne Street and is considered a landmark that serves as a front door to the University.
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible hotel and restaurant; dining hours vary by day.

cards.title: Hamilton Movie Theater
cards.subtitle: Lebanon Street
cards.notes: Catch a film or live performance at this independent theater that has served as a community centerpiece since 1895.
cards.short_summary: A historic independent cinema offering diverse film programming and community events.
cards.evidence_claim: Hamilton Theater, located at 7 Lebanon Street, has served as a centerpiece for films and community events since 1895.
cards.access_notes: Open for scheduled screenings and events; ticket purchase required for movies.

cards.title: The Hub
cards.subtitle: Lebanon Street
cards.notes: Work on your startup at this business incubator where students and local entrepreneurs collaborate in a creative workspace.
cards.short_summary: A New York State certified business incubator supporting student and regional entrepreneurship.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hub is located at 8 Lebanon Street and provides a community for entrepreneurs supported by Colgate's program.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday–Friday, 9 a.m.–5 p.m.; 24/7 access available for authorized students via GateCard.

cards.title: Hamilton Whole Foods
cards.subtitle: Broad Street
cards.notes: Grab a healthy vegetarian lunch or browse organic groceries at this community-focused shop known for its sustainability practices.
cards.short_summary: A local grocery and cafe specializing in natural, organic, and vegetarian options.
cards.evidence_claim: Hamilton Whole Foods is located at 28 Broad Street and offers healthy, vegetarian lunches and organic inventory.

cards.title: Flour & Salt
cards.subtitle: Lebanon Street
cards.notes: Order a signature bagel sandwich and coffee at this popular cafe that serves as a frequent study and social spot for students.
cards.short_summary: A local cafe and bakery famous for its bagel sandwiches and community atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: Flour & Salt operates a cafe at 37 Lebanon Street in downtown Hamilton.
cards.access_notes: Open daily for breakfast and lunch; check website for seasonal hours.

cards.title: Hamilton Eatery
cards.subtitle: Lebanon Street
cards.notes: Enjoy deli sandwiches and comfort food at this local favorite, known for its pot pies and casual dining environment.
cards.short_summary: A casual deli and restaurant offering a variety of sandwiches, burgers, and homemade pies.
cards.evidence_claim: Hamilton Eatery is located at 41 Lebanon Street and serves deli sandwiches, burgers, and more.
cards.access_notes: Open for lunch and dinner; popular for takeout and casual sit-down meals.

cards.title: Parry's
cards.subtitle: Utica Street
cards.notes: Find everything from hardware to general interest items at this long-standing local store that also offers dry cleaning services.
cards.short_summary: A versatile local hardware and general store serving the Hamilton community.
cards.evidence_claim: Parry's is located at 100 Utica Street and sells a variety of general interest items and hardware.
cards.source_title: Visitor and Guest Information | Colgate University
cards.access_notes: Open daily; provides essential supplies for students living off-campus.

cards.title: Village Green
cards.subtitle: Broad Street
cards.notes: Relax in this central park space that hosts community events, farmers markets, and serves as the heart of the historic district.
cards.short_summary: The central public park and historic common space of the village of Hamilton.
cards.evidence_claim: The Village Green offers a space for local eateries and merchants and is surrounded by historic homes.
cards.access_notes: Public park open 24/7; hosts the seasonal farmers market on Saturdays.

cards.title: Community Memorial Hospital
cards.subtitle: Broad Street
cards.notes: Access medical care and urgent care services at this facility located just north of the village center on the main corridor.
cards.short_summary: The primary healthcare provider and urgent care clinic for the Hamilton area.
cards.evidence_claim: Community Memorial Hospital is located at 150 Broad Street and includes an Urgent Care Clinic.
cards.source_title: Visitor and Guest Information | Colgate University
cards.access_notes: Hospital open 24/7; Urgent Care hours vary. Located approximately one mile from campus.
